report.explanation: Alert shows all checkout requests returning 200 with sub-300ms durations; metrics show 0 502s and p95 checkout ~412ms. No errors, no dependency metrics, no logs. Current evidence does not establish any bounded root cause; the operator latency hypothesis is not substantiated by observed data. Handing off for more evidence.
missing_evidence: Gateway logs (ev-...-gw_logs) were excluded; need them to see errors or slow spans
No dependency-operation metrics for gateway; need per-dependency latency/outcome data
Need downstream service (order, inventory, payment, postgres, redis) latency metrics to localize the slow hop
Need confirmation whether 412ms p95 checkout latency is anomalous vs baseline SLO
